method.filters: excluded thirdparty/, test/tests dirs, node_modules, static/lib; commits at the shallow boundary (listed in .git/shallow) dropped because history is cut there and every file in them looks added
known_limits: -M100% removes exact renames only; moved files that were also edited still count as new
counts are files, not functions; no per-function filtering or dedup yet
extension-only filter; generated files not yet excluded

function_level.eligible: unit of 6-40 lines (MIN_LINES/MAX_LINES in curate.py) with no tree-sitter/ast parse error inside; the identifier-compliance gate of curate.py is NOT applied
function_level.generated_filter: path pattern (.gen/.generated/.g.*, .Designer.cs, /gen/, _pb2.py) or header marker in first 1500 bytes (auto-generated, generated by, do not edit, @generated, ...)
function_level.files_at_pin: files from the added-after-cutoff list that still exist at the pinned commit (the list has 169/590/730; some were deleted or renamed after being added)
function_level.caveat: counts are before any per-standard compliance gate, so usable benchmark snippets will be fewer; heuristic generated-file filter not manually audited

function_level.unit_def: C++ provisional: tree-sitter function_definition nodes (no C++ extractor yet)

repos.distribute: commit hash + path + fetch script only (do not redistribute code)
